summary: This bill amends the General Education Provisions Act to require prior written consent from students or their parents before students can be required to participate in surveys, analyses, or evaluations that reveal personal information.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the General Education Provisions Act to require prior written consent from students (or their parents for minors) before they can be required to submit to surveys that reveal personal information. This directly impacts the administration and content of education, focusing on student privacy within the educational system. It does not directly address spending levels but rather the operational aspects of public schools related to data collection.
